
'''Feng Donglai''' is a professor of [[University of Science and Technology of China]], who works on [[condensed matter physics]].<ref>{{cite web |url=https://faculty.ustc.edu.cn/fengdonglai/zh_CN/|title=封东来|website=faculty.ustc.edu.cn|access-date=2024-05-30|language=zh}}</ref> Feng Donglai was elected as a member of the [[Chinese Academy of Sciences]] in 2021.<ref>{{cite web|url=http://finance.people.com.cn/n1/2021/1118/c1004-32285593.html|title=中国科学院2021年院士增选名单揭晓|date=2021-11-18|website=www.people.cn|access-date=2024-05-30|language=zh}}</ref> He became the President of [[ShanghaiTech University]] in June, 2024.<ref>{{cite web|url=https://www.shanghaitech.edu.cn/eng/2024/0604/c1260a1097045/page.htm|title=ShanghaiTech University announces leadership changes|date=2024-06-05|access-date=2024-06-25}}</ref>

== Honors ==
* 2005, Javed Husain Prize<ref>{{Cite web|title = Prof. Dong-Lai Feng Achieves Javed Husain Prize_English_复旦大学|url = http://news.fudan.edu.cn/2005/1207/8175.html|website = news.fudan.edu.cn|access-date = 2016-02-05}}</ref>
* 2010, AAA, Robert T. Poe Prize<ref>{{Cite web|title = AAA Award (ROBERT T. POE PRIZE) {{!}} OCPA|url = http://ocpaweb.org/home/aaa-award-robert-t-poe-prize/|website = ocpaweb.org|access-date = 2016-02-05}}</ref>
